name: @sluice/indexer
description: Yellowstone gRPC indexer, public risk terminal API and deterministic featured-issuance selection for Sluice.

engines.//: Node 22.6 is the floor, not 20.11. `npm start` runs the TypeScript sources directly via --experimental-strip-types, which landed in 22.6, and tsconfig.json sets rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, which landed in 22.7. A host that resolved the older range would install Node 20 and the start script would exit immediately with 'bad option'. Verified 2026-10-08.
